items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: I just did an album with the Winnipeg Jazz Orchestra with my friend Jill Townsend and we equally wrote the same amount of music

ctx.x: When do your titles come into play?

My titles. Someone asked — I was on an interview just before this and that same question came up. They were like, “How do you come up with your titles?” And I said well I think again it comes from — I mean again, with commissions there might be something outlined verbally about the piece. For example I just did an album with the Winnipeg Jazz Orchestra with my friend Jill Townsend and we equally wrote the same amount of music and we had a theme. So the themes were pretty easy to get into, the theme was water.…

Columbia. It’s a beautiful — it’s just all view of water and mountains, and hang out with my cousin and learning how to skip rocks. So I was trying to get the idea of rock skipping, getting past three, getting past four, getting past five, and the whole calm kind of feeling of the water lapping on the beach. So I — you know I had a lot to work with there. So it’s called “Rock Skipping Under the Half Moon” because we were always out there just before dinner or just after dinner, and then we were being called in…
